    Jelly-SPARQL benchmarks

    The following results were obtained by benchmarking Jelly-JVM 4.0.0 against the SPARQL query results formats built into Apache Jena and Eclipse RDF4J. For RDF serialization, see Jelly-RDF benchmarks.

    The charts are interactive – hover over them for details.

    Benchmark setup

    The same datasets, hardware, software, and method were used as in the Jelly-RDF benchmarks. Each of the 13 datasets was turned into a single SPARQL result set with one row per statement. Throughput is given in cells (bound values) per second.

    Tested methods

    • SPARQL Query Results XML Format (SRX) (Apache Jena, Eclipse RDF4J)
    • SPARQL Query Results JSON Format (SRJ) (Apache Jena, Eclipse RDF4J)
    • SPARQL Query Results TSV Format (Apache Jena, Eclipse RDF4J)
      • CSV was not tested, because it does not preserve datatypes or language tags.
    • Jena's binary result formats, Protobuf and Thrift (Apache Jena)
    • RDF4J Binary query results format (Eclipse RDF4J)
    • Jelly-SPARQL (Jelly-JVM 4.0.0, "big" preset) 
      max_name_table_size = 8192;
max_prefix_table_size = 1024;
max_datatype_table_size = 64;
